Cars in Forza Horizon 6 can be purchased from the Autoshow, the Auction House, or as Aftermarket Cars.

Some vehicles can only be won as Wheelspin or Super Wheelspin rewards, as prizes from completing goals in the Festival Playlist, by leveling up in the Collection Journal, as Barn Finds, as part of a car's Car Mastery tree, or as part of downloadable content packs.

Other vehicles may only be available during specific events or Showcases.

There are also special car variants called Forza Edition cars, which come with unique upgrades and body customization not found on the standard model and a gameplay progression perk.

Most unlockable cars can be viewed and bought from the Auction House. Alternatively, a selection of cars are seen throughout the map as Aftermarket Cars, where they come with Upgrades, tunes and Designs. Some cars may only be available as an aftermarket car, in which they are dubbed "Treasure Cars" and come with their own rarity.

All vehicles are assigned a rarity: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Barn Find, Treasure Car and Forza Edition.

All vehicles have a Car Type assigned, which categorizes similar vehicles together for events, PR Stunts, and multiplayer:

  • Buggies
  • Classic Muscle
  • Classic Racers
  • Classic Rally
